title: Existence of twisted Hermitian-Einstein metrics on unstable vector bundles
summary: In this paper, we demonstrate that twisted Hermitian-Einstein metrics on holomorphic vector bundles exist without obstruction. More precisely, for an arbitrary holomorphic vector bundle $E$ over a compact Kähler manifold $(M,ω_g)$, we prove that the twisted Hermitian-Einstein equation $$Λ_{ω_g}\left(\sqrt{-1}R^h\right) = λh + P$$ admits a unique smooth solution $h$, provided that $P\inΓ(M,E^*\otimes\bar{E}^*)$ is positive-definite and $λ<λ_E^-$. The constant $λ_E^-$ is intrinsically associated with the stability constant of $E$. This result extends the classical Donaldson-Uhlenbeck-Yau (DUY)…
